verses.verse:
स्वेच्छया वायुनाऽरण्ये बंशखण्डो निनाद्यते।
एक स्वरा स्वयं भूता बंशी सा देवनिर्मिता।।६।।
verses.text: When a piece of bamboo in the forest is sounded by the wind of its own accord, that single-note, self-born bānsurī is made by the gods.

commentary.text: That is: from whenever half-cut bamboos in the forest began to sound by themselves through the impact of the wind, from then the origin of the ekasvarā (single-note) bānsurī should be reckoned, which we can call devanirmitā (god-made).
